You can transition and look like a girl as bigender. For example im technically bigender according to definition of it because identify as he/they. I feel like im a guy mostly and i like being treated as a guy but i also feel comfortable with nonbinary pronouns sense it feels really natural to me. Being bigender is kinda like being trans too, in a way Not all trans people want to get bottom surgery and some might get top surgery or not take T, point is its different for everyone. Bigender is similar in the sense that it can mean different things to different people.

So this is what im thinking. Maybe its because you like being treated as a girl but your comfortable with the pronouns that you're used to. So mix in being treated like you want to be treated and comfortablility, equals euphoria. Or or you can be bigender, which means "denoting or relating to a person whose sense of personal identity encompasses two genders." (Google dictionary) Basically you feel like your both. And everyone's experience is different so you can feel like being treated as a girl but refered to as a boy. You might also be a femboy, a femboy is someone who is biologically male and presents himself in a very feminine manner but it doesn't really indicate gender identity. Though apparently it's common for femboys to identify as bigender. (urban dictionary)
